newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-United News upped at BZW.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-United News upped at BZW.

text.p: United News & Media Plc was raised to "buy" from "hold" at BZW following results which beat its expectations, market sources said on Monday.

Dealers said BZW analysts said they expected a recovery in United's poorer performing divisions such as national newspapers and expected overall earnings growth of 17 percent and 10.6 percent in the next two years.
They said there was a possibility of further upside to earnings forecasts as other poorly performing units were reorganised, dealers said.
BZW analysts were not immediately available for comment.
Last Friday United said pre-tax profit rose to 290.2 million stg in the year to December 31 from 258.7 million a year before, prompting a round of analyst upgrades.
